mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK) and OSMR (cytokine receptor, JAK1-associated) are forced into close proximity by a flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å). FGFR1's tyrosine kinase transphosphorylates JAK1-associated tyrosines on OSMR's ICD, while JAK1 reciprocally phosphorylates FGFR1 tyrosines — enhancing FRS2-GRB2-SOS1 (MAPK/ERK) and FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 (PI3K/AKT) signaling. FGFR1 also directly phosphorylates STAT3, amplifying the JAK/STAT3 arm. PLCG1 is sterically excluded by the asymmetric ECD geometry (FGFR1 ~370 aa vs OSMR ~600 aa) with a short linker, suppressing Ca2+/NFAT signaling. The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a young transcriptional phenotype by upregulating contractile/structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) via SRF/ELK1 and downregulating aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory markers (IL32, TXNIP).
